ring_convention.edges_m: [radius+1 for inversion or radius for forward,500,1000,10000,100000]
ring_convention.inversion: First2 generated rings only; shore+1m strict analytical eligibility excludes one metre as a declared numerical/support convention, not a measured shoreline buffer.
ring_convention.forward: All4 generated rings begin at static shore; first2 local, remaining2 regional to100km.
ring_convention.areas: pi*(outer^2-inner^2), same generated terrestrial area; all land beyond shore assumed, not measured.
ring_convention.coherence: Means/areas are evaluated separately for inversion shore+1 and forward shore; no reuse of circular_receiver_annulus K. Source-compatible GPM-neutral analytical operator is used with its own radius/support meaning.

anchor_policy: Ascending stable numeric native_site_id in each training fold; rotate small-lake regional proxies, explicitly not qualified large-lake REVEALS. Never access heldout pollen in reconstruction.
bin_support: Six independent 3-record requests. Pairing coordinate=younger bin edge solely as exact key; age_support_bp is the declared pooled bin-stationarity support, not recovered native age uncertainty. Native named CalBP chronologies/AD1950 preserved; missing bounds remain missing.
projection: BOKE Fraxinus and other Solsoe labels are explicitly outside Betula/Ulmus estimand. Preserve original saved panel_N, projected panel_N, excluded count mass and exact source-support hash. No source-absent zero.
baseline_degeneracy: Two training places leave one regional anchor and one local predictor per fold. All3 spatial baselines reduce to same single local reconstructed composition, not evidence for spatial interpolation choice.
uncertainty: Retain existing analytical native SE/diagnostics if generated; no chronology/basin/parameter-domain/spatial-model/PPE-covariance propagation or calibrated ecological interval claim.
exposure: Prior-exposed development. Materialization opens all retained counts before fitting and scoring. Source-exclusion and prediction-before-score are not untouched information-isolation.
rights: Use existing derived conditional local Neotoma scope and constituent attribution. Historical NR/NR/R and unresolved source metadata retained. No new source-use decision, raw redistribution, historical author/PANGAEA or full scientific admission.
scope: Conditional3-place Betula/Ulmus source-driven coupled REVEALS/analytical LOVE and forward baseline experiment only; six bins/18possiblefolds. No original historical input equivalence, qualified regional-lake profile, four-country validation, measured vegetation, untouched confirmation or full S3/physical validation.
